name: Tracksmith
why: Running clothes in a collegiate style from Boston: the Van Cortlandt singlet, merino and the sash stripe, sold from two Trackhouses and specialty running shops.
origin: Founded in 2014 in Wellesley, Massachusetts, USA by Matt Taylor.

craft_evidence.owned: NONE found (evidence: How We Work lists contract manufacturers in Poland, Portugal, China, Taiwan, Malaysia, Canada, USA; Trackhouse Boston is store + offices, not a factory)
craft_evidence.makers: evidence on PDP: FILATI (Brighton seamless merino, "producing successful seamless staples in Europe since 2016"); P&R Têxteis, Portugal (Strata bodywear). Feed vendor field (not on pages) also names 99 Degrees (Grayboy), In Record Time, Ningbo Anwei Woolen Textile (Cashmere Sweater)
craft_evidence.mills: evidence: Schoeller Textil AG / Schoeller® named on Strata Tee, Strata Singlet, Bislett Pants and How We Work ("We work closely with the team at Schoeller in Switzerland"); Polartec® on Franklin Fleece. Bravio/Inverno described only as Italian fabric, mill unnamed
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: About page "launched in 2014 with a shop in Wellesley, MA"; 12 years, no earlier lineage claimed
craft_evidence.process: partial (evidence): PDPs give gsm, micron, knit type (seamless engineered merino mesh by FILATI; high-gauge pointelle Italian knit; open-end cotton jersey); How We Work names manufacturing countries a
